verdict.rationale: Jan ships an OpenAI-compatible local API server (localhost:1337) for external app integration, documented in the GitHub README, but probes found no public OpenAPI/Swagger spec or llms.txt on jan.ai, suggesting the API is only lightly documented rather than a fully specified public API. missing for 10: a discoverable formal API reference (openapi.json/swagger), example client code, and independent confirmation of API stability/versioning.
